URL: https://www.understandingwar.org/backgrounder/iran-update-special-report-july-16-2026
(Institute for the Study of War — Iran Update Special Report, July 16, 2026. Retrieved via WebFetch.)

Key Takeaways (verbatim):
1. "Iran is trying to deter expanded US strikes by signaling that it could escalate against international shipping around the Bab al Mandeb, using the Houthis."
2. "The United States has continued its effort to degrade the Iranian ability to attack commercial traffic around the Strait of Hormuz."
3. "The IRGC is trying to send FPV, fiber-optic drones to Lebanese Hezbollah."

Iran-Houthi Coordination: Two senior Iranian sources informed Reuters that Iran requested the Houthis prepare to attack Red Sea shipping if the US expands strikes to Iranian energy infrastructure. IRGC Quds Force Commander Brigadier General Esmail Ghaani previously threatened Houthi campaigns against shipping.

US Military Operations: The US struck Semnan Airport in Semnan Province, multiple sites in Sistan and Baluchistan Province (approx. 130 km from the southern coast), and coastal installations near Bandar Abbas and Greater Tunb Island.

Hezbollah Weapons Transfers: Syrian forces seized a weapons shipment intended for Hezbollah, including hundreds of 13-inch FPV drones, Chinese-made fibre-optic components, Iranian anti-tank warheads, and 2026-manufactured Almas ATGMs.

Iranian Retaliation: The IRGC and Artesh launched drone and missile attacks against US bases in Bahrain, Kuwait, and Jordan on July 15-16; all were reportedly intercepted.

Negotiations Status: Iran's Judiciary outlet denied claims of releasing a US detainee, contradicting Trump's statements about an American citizen leaving Iran.
